item.title: Badly overgrown vegetation on Benhall green back of Whittington road properties., 20th August
item.description:
Council ride on grass cutters for years used to go to boundaries of Whittington Road properties and that was great thank you. As this ceased the vegetation, most significantly brambles have grown very high and spill over into gardens. Folk that are able, try to cut back what they can overhanging into their gardens, however this is difficult task for older residents. It is preventing access to carry out fence / boundary maintenance and access to green through gates etc. We understand you are busy but as the benhall gardening group have been advised not to touch this area and residents understand it is council land vegetation has got out of hand.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 36, Whittington Road, Hatherley, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet
